title: No Problem
desc: Raj is determined to lead an honest life and quit committing petty crimes. However, his friend and accomplice, Yash, always lands them in trouble and leads him further away from a crime-free life.

title: Suhaag
desc: Best friends Ajay and Raj are goofy college-going boys, who love playing pranks on others. Ajay's life turns upside down after he finds out about a tragic incident related to his estranged father, which might put his friendship with Raj at stake.

title: Maidan E Jung
desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.
